role: The session.* (overnight record, by ordinal/id/date, tail walking), workout full-record builder shared with workout.*/walks.*, walks.* (walk/hike aggregates), training.* (live and historical CTL/ATL/TSB/ACWR from TrainingMetricsCache, by-sport TRIMP) and heat.acclimation.* assistant fact namespaces.
types: SessionNamespace: struct — session.* facts + workout record helpers (extension)
TrainingLoadNamespace: struct — training.* facts (projections/trajectory in other files)
HeatAcclimationNamespace.Computed: private struct — a finished heat compute's readout (nil when nothing to score), so a timeout is told apart from no readout
state: HeatAcclimationNamespace.stillComputing: private static let FactValue — missing(notYetComputed) answer for a compute past the 8 s cap
toplevel: Namespace structs hold namespace strings ('session','walks','training','heat'), the injected SessionArchive and settings closure; TrainingLoadNamespace and HeatAcclimationNamespace reach shared caches through AppDependencies.current (service location) rather than injected dependencies.
